text: مِن پکائے، سمجھ الائے، کدے خطا نہ کھائے۔
romanized: Min pakāe, samajh alāe, kade khatā na khāe.
literal_en: The man who measures his food before cooking it, and thinks before speaking, never makes a mistake.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
